evidence: Labeled Wallet, changes descriptor handling and keypool refill logic in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp, src/wallet/imports.cpp, and src/script/descriptor.cpp.
rationale: Fixes node aborts and signed integer overflows triggered by descriptor imports ending at 2^31-1 and boundary-case keypool refill requests. Multiple reviewers reproduced and confirmed the crash on master, verifying that the PR safely rejects out-of-bounds ranges without crashing.
